title: A Night at the Roxbury
about: Two brothers who work in their dad's fake plant shop try every night to get into the hottest club in LA.
cue: Serve the snacks when the Butabi brothers finally make it past the door.
faces: COVER AT THE DOOR, NO DRESS CODE
Tonight's plan, bro: grab a good table, bob your head between bites, and act like we're on the list.
Mini cheeseburgers with dill pickles on slider buns.
Carrot, celery, cucumber and capsicum sticks with a herb sour cream dip.
Smoky chipotle lime chicken thighs in warm tortillas.
Benny Zadir, the club owner who loves the brothers' idea for a club.
Biscuit base and raspberry cream cheese mousse in glasses.
Vodka, orange liqueur, cranberry and lime, shaken and served up.

Two drink minimum at the stage tables. Cover charge after nine. No discussing the synchronized head bob at the tables. Card No. 1998. Showtime: Serve the snacks when the Butabi brothers finally make it past the door.

The Roxbury Velvet RopeA Night at the RoxburyHead bobbing optional. Snacks mandatory.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersRoxbury club slidersMini cheeseburgers with dill pickles on slider bunsHow to make it500g beef mince6 slices of cheddar12 slider buns1 jar dill pickles1 bottle tomato sauceShape the beef mince into small patties and season.Cook on a hot pan for 2 minutes a side, adding half a cheddar slice to each at the end.Put in the slider buns with pickles and sauce.Fake plant shop cruditésCarrot, celery, cucumber and capsicum sticks with a herb sour cream dipHow to make it2 carrots2 celery sticks1 cucumber1 red capsicum200g sour cream1 bunch parsley1 bunch chives1 lemonCut the carrots, the celery sticks, the cucumber and the red capsicum into sticks and stand them in jars.Blitz the sour cream with parsley, chives and a squeeze of lemon for the dip.MainsSunset Strip chipotle chicken tacosSmoky chipotle lime chicken thighs in warm tortillasHow to make it800g chicken thigh fillets1 tin chipotle in adobo2 garlic cloves4 limesground cumin, to tastevegetable oil, to taste1 red onion2 avocados12 small flour tortillas1 bunch corianderMix the chipotle in adobo, the crushed garlic cloves, the juice of the lime, the cumin and the oil.Marinate the chicken thigh fillets for 30 minutes.Slice the red onion thin and soak in lime juice and salt for 20 minutes.Grill the chicken on a hot barbecue for 5 minutes a side and slice.Mash the avocados with lime and salt.Warm the small tortillas and fill with avocado, chicken, onion and coriander.Mr Zadir's lamb koobidehBenny Zadir, the club owner who loves the brothers' idea for a clubHow to make it800g lamb mince1 brown onion1 tsp ground sumac1 tsp ground turmeric300g basmati rice1 pinch saffron30g butter4 tomatoes200g Greek yoghurt1 mint1 parsleyGrate the onion, squeeze out the juice and mix with the lamb, turmeric and salt until sticky. Shape around 8 flat skewers.Soak the saffron in 2 tbsp hot water. Simmer the rice with 600ml water, covered, for 12 minutes, rest for 5, then stir through the saffron and butter.Grill the kebabs and halved tomatoes on a hot grill for 5 minutes a side.Mix the yoghurt with chopped mint and salt.Dust the kebabs with sumac and serve on the rice with the tomatoes, yoghurt and parsley.SweetsNeon pink raspberry cheesecake cupsBiscuit base and raspberry cream cheese mousse in glassesHow to make it150g plain sweet biscuits60g butter250g raspberries110g icing sugar250g cream cheesevanilla extract, to taste200ml thickened cream30g white chocolateCrush the plain sweet biscuits and mix with the melted butter.Press into glasses.Blitz the raspberries with the icing sugar and strain.Beat the cream cheese with the icing sugar and the vanilla, then fold in the whipped cream.Fold half the raspberry sauce through to turn it pink.Spoon into the glasses, swirl the rest of the sauce on top and chill 2 hours.Finish with raspberries and grated white chocolate.DrinksClub cosmopolitanVodka, orange liqueur, cranberry and lime, shaken and served upHow to make it160ml vodka60ml orange liqueur500ml cranberry juice2 limesShake the vodka, the orange liqueur, the cranberry juice and the lime juice with ice for each glass.Strain into chilled glasses.Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
